viewing_check: Check species and grade: Huon pine has a distinctive sweet smell when scratched or cut at an edge, very fine tight grain, and often small bird's-eye or pencil-stripe figure. Plain coarse pale grain with no scent means another pine (celery top, king William or non-Tasmanian) worth only the low end. Also check width, length, thickness, and checks or splits.
